items.title: Prediction Market Platform
items.description: Polymarket is a decentralized prediction market platform built on Polygon. Uses hybrid-decentralized Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) with off-chain matching and on-chain settlement. Operates binary markets with YES/NO tokens summing to $1.00. Zero trading fees for most markets, UMA oracle for resolution.

items.title: Official CLOB Client SDK
items.description: Polymarket provides official Python SDK (py-clob-client) for CLOB API integration, plus REST APIs for market data, trades, and order book snapshots. WebSocket feeds available for real-time price updates. EIP-712 signed messages for on-chain settlement.

items.title: Arbitrage Opportunities
items.description: Primary alpha source: Combinatorial arbitrage (risk-free when YES+NO < $1.00). 50-200 daily opportunities with 0.5-2% profit margins. CLOB model enables tighter spreads and higher liquidity vs traditional AMMs.
